en:
Ouch...
Kaito almost pummeled me to death...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kokichi for a while?

...Althooough, I don't plan on dying so soon,
y'know?

When I become the victim...or the culprit...
I'll set up lots of tricks...
So everyone can have loads of fun...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time convincing Kokichi
not to do anything stupid.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today,
despite my misgivings...
